adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Coordinated, harmonious movements of the body.
movement_profile.partnering: The 'punga' or 'umbigada' serves as a ritualized invitation between dancers.

signature_moves.description: A movement where a dancer in the center bumps her belly against the belly of another dancer in the circle.
signature_moves.name: Punga

music_profile.musical_form: Improvisational singing led by a main singer.
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Driven by three drums (parelhas) and matracas.
music_profile.sound_description: A rhythmic, percussive sound dominated by the deep resonance of three handmade drums tuned by fire, accompanied by the sharp clatter of matracas and vibrant, improvisational vocal call-and-response.

basic_steps: Form a circle with other dancers.
Step rhythmically to the beat of the drums.
Enter the center of the circle to dance individually.
Perform the 'punga' to invite another dancer to the center.
teaching.rhythm: Percussive, driven by the three drums.
